items.title: Has Wall Street Given Up On Oracle Stock Too Soon?
items.summary: The market has punished Oracle's stock like a laggard, even as its valuation multiple sits near the top of its peer group and profitability remains strong.

items.title: Is International Business Machines (IBM) Undervalued On Its New Dual Architecture Mainframe Chip?
items.summary: International Business Machines (IBM) unveiled a dual architecture mainframe processor that can natively run IBM and Arm instructions on the same core, prompting investors to reassess how the stock reflects its infrastructure ambitions. items.title: Is IBM Stock A Bargain After Its 28% Drawdown?
items.summary: The software line that fell hardest at IBM is the one its upside case runs through, and the capacity behind it is already installed.

items.title: How Asia Is Becoming Quantum Computing’s Next Battleground
items.summary: Recently public quantum companies like Quantinuum, IQM, and Infleqtion are steadily scaling up their presence in the region.

items.title: Quantum Stocks Looked Like Nvidia in 2019. Then They Belly-Flopped 50%.
items.summary: Quantum stocks crashed around 50%, but IonQ raised guidance while Rigetti and D-Wave held key strengths. The selloff may have created a new opportunity.

items.title: Deloitte to pay $21.5 million to end Trump administration DEI probe
items.summary: Deloitte will pay $21.5 million to resolve DOJ claims that it discriminated against employees and job applicants on the basis of race or sex.

items.title: Dell Stock's Massive Guidance Raise Has A Catch
items.summary: Management put a stunning new number on its full-year earnings, and the market is buying the story. But the real question is whether this is a new era of growth or customers pulling forward tomorrow's demand into today.
